# planning-camera-and-framing (reference summary)

## Purpose
Plan camera, composition, resolution, and aspect ratio, and check framing quality against written criteria.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/planning-camera-and-framing/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/planning-camera-and-framing/contract.json` (`v2.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `scene-planners` / `camera-composition-framing-and-aspect-planner`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- Camera angle, lens, or framing needs a plan.
- Resolution or aspect ratio must match a delivery target.
- Composition needs a check against written criteria.

## Trigger cues
- "improve composition and camera"
- "choose hero framing"
- "set camera strategy for product hero"
- "is the framing okay"
- "check composition"
- "subject feels off-center"
- "too much negative space"
- "what resolution"
- "how big should the render be"
- "16:9 or square"

- to design lighting rigs or surface materials/lookdev → delegate to `planning-lighting-and-materials` (`references/skills/planning-lighting-and-materials.md`; use planning-lighting-and-materials)
- to choose delivery file formats → delegate to `choosing-render-and-output` (`references/skills/choosing-render-and-output.md`; use choosing-render-and-output)

- material validation → delegate to `planning-lighting-and-materials` (`references/skills/planning-lighting-and-materials.md`; use planning-lighting-and-materials)
- lighting validation → delegate to `planning-lighting-and-materials` (`references/skills/planning-lighting-and-materials.md`; use planning-lighting-and-materials)
- broad scene Pass/Warn/Fail readiness review → delegate to `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`; use verifying-before-handoff)
- classifying render or export artifact evidence → delegate to `verifying-before-handoff` (`references/skills/verifying-before-handoff.md`; use verifying-before-handoff)
- pure modeling → delegate to `choosing-render-and-output` (`references/skills/choosing-render-and-output.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to choosing-render-and-output)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `domain_scene_plan` (`object`): Upstream scene layout plan defining subject scale, staging, and depth layers
- `framing_goal` (`string`): Target shot type (hero three-quarter, orthographic catalog grid, portrait, wide establishing)

### Optional inputs
- `pinned_aspect_ratio` (`string`): Aspect ratio lock from planning-camera-and-framing
- `camera_and_framing_spec` (`object`): Camera focal length, sensor, angle, and subject placement from planning-camera-and-framing
- `pinned_aspect_ratio_and_subject` (`object`): Locked aspect ratio and primary/secondary focal hierarchy from brief
- `viewport_or_render_preview_notes` (`string`): Optional framing observations from a viewport or preview capture
- `target_delivery_surfaces` (`array`): Target display placements (desktop hero banner, mobile portrait feed, 1:1 e-commerce card, 4K print)
- `framing_and_crop_strategy` (`string`): Whether deliverables use a single master aspect ratio with safe-zone crops or separate camera setups
- `render_time_constraints` (`string`): Optional render time ceiling influencing pixel dimensions and percentage scale

### Primary outputs
- `camera_rig_specification`
- `focal_length_and_dof_plan`
- `composition_anchor_guidelines`
- `composition_verdict_table`
- `silhouette_and_headroom_assessment`
- `camera_replan_remediation_hints`
- `pinned_pixel_dimensions_and_aspect_ratio`
- `safe_frame_and_overscan_margins`
- `camera_sensor_fit_alignment_notes`
